node.statement: Fix i,j. The hypotheses Z_ij in S_{P,R}, X_j in S_{R,Q}, and Y_i in S_{P,Q} permit direct application of def-ha-map, giving (Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j + Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j) = 2*<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>*\widetilde Q. Substituting the definitional equality \widetilde Q=u_Q from the preceding notation bridge gives exactly the coordinate identity asserted in node 1.2.1.
